say:1:1530221401:1.text: What's the point of hunting alone?
say:1:1530221401:1.source_cn: 一个人打猎，能有什么好的？

say:2:1530221402:1.text: I envy the ones who got away. They just up and left this whole mess behind!
say:2:1530221402:1.source_cn: 真羡慕那些逃跑的家伙，可以转身离开水泽营地……

say:4:1530221403:1.source_cn: 我可不行，我阿爹阿娘，还有我弟弟，他们都还在水泽营地。

say:5:1530221404:1.text: If I run, the Halians will make them suffer on my account.
